title: Manhunt Necessities
description: A modpack that adds the necessities for a manhunt with a twist...
body:
# **What Are The Mods**

The mods that are in the modpack are:

AppleSkin,
Dynamic Lights,
Essential Mod,
Fabric API,
Fresh Animations,
Just Enough Items (JEI),
Manhunt,
Moteschen's Better Leaves,
And A Random Mod That Changes Every Month

# **Can I add My own Mods**

Yes, all you have to do is click the add content button to add your own mods.

# **Can I play With Friends**

Yes, this modpack adds the mod Essential Mod to play together, Emote, and many more features.

# **What mod gets added every month**

A random mod adding a fun twist to your minecraft manhunt. (I also delete the old mod first)
